title: Maxay A1, A2, B1, B2, C1 iyo C2 ka dhigan yihiin?
invitation: Koodhadhkan heerarka ah waxaad ku aragtaa buugaag, koorsooyin, imtixaano, apps iyo profile-yo luqadeed adduunka oo dhan. Halkan waxaan ku sharxaynaa waxa ay dhab ahaan ka dhigan yihiin, sababta xirfadahaagu heerar kala duwan u yeelan karaan, iyo sida Gef u isticmaalo.
summary: Gef wuxuu CEFR A1–C2 u adeegsadaa khariidad wadaag ah oo awoodda luqadda, wuxuu Pre-A1 u hayaa tallaabooyinka ugu horreeya, wuxuuna ka sarreysiyaa C2 xulashadiisa ‘Si buuxda u faseexa / Heer af-hooyo’. Awooddaada dhabta ahi waxay ku kala duwanaan kartaa akhris, dhegeysi, hadal, qoraal, isdhexgal iyo dhex-dhexaadin.

blocks.title: Khariidad wadaag ah oo awoodda luqadda
blocks.text: A1 ilaa C2 waxay ka yimaadaan Common European Framework of Reference for Languages, ama CEFR. Waxay bartayaasha, macallimiinta, dugsiyada, imtixaannada iyo daabacayaasha siisaa hab wadaag ah oo looga hadlo awoodda luqadda. A iyo B ma aha darajooyin dugsi, Gef-na ma qiyaaso in luqad kasta ay leedahay jid ereyo ama naxwe oo isku mid ah.

blocks.title: Pre-A1 · Tallaabooyinka ugu horreeya
blocks.text: Pre-A1 waa heerka ka hor A1. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad garato erayo, calaamado, dhawaaqyo, magacyo, tirooyin ama weedho la xafiday, laakiin weli aad u baahan tahay taageero badan. Qalabka CEFR ee casriga ah wuxuu leeyahay Pre-A1. Miisaanka fudud ee Gef, bartamaha wuxuu ka dhigan yahay aqoon eber ah, tallaabada bannaanka ugu horreysana waa A1.

blocks.title: A1 · Bilow
blocks.text: A1 waxaad wax waxtar leh ku samayn kartaa luqad yar xaalado la yaqaan oo cad. Waxaad fahmi kartaa qoraal gaaban oo fudud oo aad isweydaarsan kartaa xog aasaasi ah. U socoshada A2 waxay ka dhigan tahay ku tiirsanaanta weedho la xafiday oo yaraata iyo maaraynta xaalado badan oo maalinle ah kaligaa.

blocks.title: A2 · Maalinle
blocks.text: A2 nolosha maalinlaha ah ayaa luqadda ku sii maaraynaysa: dad, meelo, shaqo ama dugsi, wax iibsasho, safar, waqti iyo baahiyo degdeg ah. U socoshada B1 waxay ka dhigan tahay isku xidhidda fikradaha qaybo dheer, sharaxaadda sababo fudud iyo maaraynta xaalado aan si fudud loo saadaalin karin.

blocks.title: B1 · Madax-bannaan
blocks.text: B1 waxaad maarayn kartaa xaalado caadi ah oo badan adigoon jumlad kasta horay u qorshayn. Waxaad raaci kartaa macnaha ugu weyn ee luqad cad oo dheer, waxaadna si isku xidhan uga hadli kartaa waayo-aragnimo, qorshe, doorbid, aragti iyo dhibaato. B2 wuxuu u baahan yahay baaxad, faahfaahin, xawaare iyo xakameyn badan.

blocks.title: B2 · Madax-bannaani xooggan
blocks.text: B2 waxaad si wax ku ool ah uga qayb geli kartaa isgaarsiin dheer, ka doodi kartaa fikrado muuqda iyo kuwo abstract ah, waxaadna ka shaqayn kartaa xaalado bulsho, waxbarasho iyo xirfadeed oo badan. U socoshada C1 waxay u baahan tahay xakameyn ka sii fiican oo inference, nuance, register, abaabul iyo style ah.

blocks.title: C1 · Sare
blocks.text: C1 luqaddu waxay noqotaa qalab dabacsan. Waxaad maarayn kartaa wax adag, fahmi kartaa macne aan si toos ah loo sheegin, waxaadna la qabsan kartaa codka iyo style-ka xaaladda. U socoshada C2 waxay ka badan tahay qoto-dheer, kala duwanaansho yar, dib-u-habayn degdeg ah, meelo takhasus ah iyo xakameyn sax ah intii ay ka ahaan lahayd liis naxwe oo ugu dambeeya.

blocks.title: C2 · Xirfad aad u sarreysa
blocks.text: C2 waa heerka tixraaca guud ee ugu sarreeya CEFR. Qof C2 ah wuxuu maarayn karaa luqad aad u adag isagoo si fiican u xakameeya macne, qaab-dhismeed, implication iyo style. C2 macnaheedu ma aha inaad taqaan eray kasta, aadan weligaa qaldamin, ama si toos ah u noqoto qof afkiisu hooyo yahay.

blocks.title: Si buuxda u faseexa / Heer af-hooyo · Is-sharaxaadda ugu sarreysa Gef
blocks.text: Gef wuxuu C2 ka sarreysiiyay xulashadiisa Si buuxda u faseexa / Heer af-hooyo. Tani ma aha CEFR C3 ama shahaado rasmi ah. Qof aan afkaasi hooyo u ahayn wuu dooran karaa haddii awooddiisa dhabta ah ee xirfaddaasi la barbar dhigi karo qof weyn oo afkiisu hooyo yahay oo si buuxda u faseexa. Gef wuxuu sharxayaa awood, ma aha asal.

blocks.title: Awooddaada luqadeed waa qaab, ma aha hal xaraf
blocks.text: Lix xirfadood way kala duwanaan karaan: Akhris, Dhegeysi, Hadal, Qoraal, Isdhexgal iyo Dhex-dhexaadin. Waxaad akhriska ka noqon kartaa C1, dhegeysiga B2, hadalka A2. Radar graph lix-geesood ah ayaa muujinaya farqigaas.

blocks.title: Heerku ma aha checklist-ka casharradii hore oo dhan
blocks.text: Barashada luqaddu si siman uma korto. Waxaad seegi kartaa mabda’ naxwe oo hore adigoo meel kale xirfad sare ku leh. Gef heerka wuxuu ugu isticmaalaa inuu muujiyo sawirka guud ee waxa aad qaban karto; B2 macnaheedu ma aha in casharrada A1 iyo A2 oo dhan si qumman loo dhammeeyay.

blocks.title: Gef hadda wuxuu cabbiraa Akhris, ma aha hexagon-ka oo dhan
blocks.text: Gef hadda waa reading-first app. Waxaad iskaa u sheegi kartaa lixda xirfadood, laakiin evidence ka imanaya buugaag, casharro akhris, faham iyo dictionary use waa inuu beddelaa Reading estimate oo keliya. Gef ma aha inuu ka qiyaaso Speaking, Listening, Writing, Interaction ama Mediation hawsha akhriska.

blocks.title: Calaamadda A2 ee buuggu waxay ka hadlaysaa buugga
blocks.text: Haddii Gef buug ku calaamadiyo A2, waa signal dhibka akhriska. Dhammeystirka buuggu waa evidence ku saabsan Akhris, laakiin ma caddaynayo in xirfadaha kale oo dhan A2 yihiin. Imtixaankana waa in la fiiriyaa waxa dhab ahaan la cabbiray.

blocks.title: Waa maxay dhex-dhexaadin?
blocks.text: Dhex-dhexaadintu waa caawinta macnaha inuu ka gudbo farqi. Waxay ka mid tahay turjumaad iyo tarjumaad toos ah, soo koobidda qoraal adag, sharaxaadda fikrad luqad fudud, gudbinta xog u dhexaysa dad aan hal af wadaagin, ama dib-u-habaynta khilaaf si labada dhinac u fahmaan.

blocks.title: Horumarka koorsadu wuxuu bixin karaa tilmaam waxtar leh
blocks.text: Qaar ka mid ah apps waxay daabacaan xiriirka koorsadooda iyo CEFR. Duolingo Score: 0–29 A1, 30–59 A2, 60–99 B1, 100–129 B2, 130–160 C1/C2. Tani waa course progress, ma aha imtixaan madax-bannaan oo dhammaan xirfadaha ah; Gef wuxuu original score u hayaa hal evidence.

blocks.title: Dunidu waxay leedahay nidaamyo badan oo heer luqadeed
blocks.text: CEFR ma aha nidaamka keliya. ACTFL waxaa laga adeegsadaa waxbarashada luqadda Maraykanka, ILR 0–5 xaalado dawladeed qaarkood, CLB/NCLC Kanada, JLPT N5–N1 Jabaaniis, HSK Mandarin. Ujeeddooyinkoodu way kala duwan yihiin, sidaas darteed Gef ma qiyaaso perfect one-to-one equivalent.

blocks.title: Tusaale: JLPT Jabaaniis
blocks.text: Laga bilaabo Diseembar 2025, natiijo JLPT oo baas ah waxay muujin kartaa official CEFR reference level oo ku salaysan JLPT level iyo total score. Laakiin JLPT wuxuu cabbiraa language knowledge, reading iyo listening; ma cabbiro speaking, writing ama interaction. Mapping-ku waa inuu saameeyaa oo keliya xirfadaha dhab ahaan la cabbiray.

blocks.title: HSK Shiinaha wuu is beddelayaa, sidaas darteed version-ku waa muhiim
blocks.text: HSK waa standardized Mandarin test. HSK 2.0 wuxuu leeyahay lix level iyo xiriir taariikhi ah CEFR. HSK 3.0 cusub waxaa loo qaabeeyay saddex stage iyo sagaal level, laakiin kala-guurka 2026 wali wuu socdaa. Gef wuxuu kaydiyaa HSK version wuxuuna nine-level-to-CEFR conversion u arkaa estimate ilaa official concordance la daabaco.

blocks.title: Framework iyo test isku mid ma aha
blocks.text: CEFR waa framework lagu sharaxo proficiency. Imtixaano iyo ururo waxay natiijooyinkooda la align-gareyn karaan. Score wuxuu u baahan yahay context: xirfadaha la cabbiray, sida iyo goorta alignment la sameeyay, iyo in natiijadu official tahay ama estimate. Gef estimate ma aha in loo bandhigo official CEFR certificate.

blocks.title: Ma jiro hal universal A2 word count
blocks.text: Vocabulary waa muhiim, laakiin CEFR ma qeexo A1, A2 ama B1 tiro go’an oo erayo ah. Luqaduhu way ku kala duwan yihiin word segmentation, writing system, compounds, morphology iyo habaynta macnaha. English vocabulary estimate si toos ah looguma koobiyeyn karo luqad kasta.

blocks.title: Sida Gef u isticmaalo levels
blocks.text: Gef wuxuu CEFR A1–C2 u isticmaalaa shared coordinates, Pre-A1 first steps, iyo heerkiisa Si buuxda u faseexa / Heer af-hooyo xulashada ugu sarreysa. Buugaagtu waxay leeyihiin reading difficulty, profile-na wuxuu kaydin karaa lix skill values. Language-specific curriculum data waxay si gaar ah u sharaxdaa concepts, word senses, grammar, scripts iyo text types.

blocks.title: Gefstimate waa estimate, ma aha diploma
blocks.text: Haddii Gef mustaqbalka isu geeyo evidence soo noqnoqda, English UI wuxuu estimate-ka u yeeri karaa Gefstimate. Wordplay-gaas laguma khasbayo luqadaha kale. Waa evidence-based estimate oo skill gaar ah, ma aha official CEFR certificate, Gef-na waa inuu sharxi karaa evidence-ka la adeegsaday.

blocks.title: Sidee loogu gudbaa level-ka xiga?
blocks.text: Ma aha adigoo buuxiya hal magic progress bar. Future Gef estimates waxay isku dari karaan lesson performance, difficulty-ga wax aad si guul leh u akhriday, help-ka aad u baahan tahay, comprehension results iyo skill-related evidence kale. Vocabulary iyo grammar way caawiyaan, laakiin ma aha hal gate. Hal buug oo fudud si toos ah kuu kor uma qaado, hal maalin adag si toos ah kuu hoos uma dhigto.

blocks.title: Si kooban
blocks.description: Eber wuxuu ka dhigan yahay aqoon wali ma jirto. Pre-A1 waa tallaabooyinka ugu horreeya. A1 iyo A2 waxay dhisaan awood maalinle oo aasaasi ah. B1 iyo B2 waxay muujiyaan madax-bannaani sii kordhaysa. C1 iyo C2 waa proficiency sare, dabacsan oo sax ah. Gef wuxuu dusha ka saaraa heerkiisa Si buuxda u faseexa / Heer af-hooyo. Awooddaada dhabta ahi waa qaabka lixda xirfadood.
